own_solution.law: Static equilibrium of the cube: T + m g = F_b, with Archimedes F_b = rho_liquid V g and m = rho_cube V; T = (rho_liquid - rho_cube) V g = (1000 - 600)(0.1^3)(9.8) = 3.92 N
assumptions: cube fully submerged and at rest
liquid incompressible and uniform, so buoyancy independent of depth
cube not touching tank walls or bottom

T5B91.regime: string intact: tension below breaking threshold (3.92 N < 50 N)

TF230.regime: string intact: tension below its 50 N limit (3.92 N < 50 N)

defect_reasons.other: TA799 ('Afterwards, the cube was held completely under a liquid of 1250 kg/m^3') is ambiguous in time: it can be read as a later, separate event (D, answer 3.92 N) or as the situation now being asked about (R, answer 6.37 N); the tense makes the D reading most likely but it is less clean than T0853.

notes: Base: V = 1.0e-3 m^3, buoyancy 9.8 N, weight 5.88 N, T = 3.92 N. TB226 (replacement liquid 1250 kg/m^3): T = (1250-600)(1e-3)(9.8) = 6.37 N. Depth sentences TF251/TACF8: pressure at top and bottom faces depends on depth but the net (buoyant) force does not for an incompressible liquid, so C. Breaking-strength sentences T5B91/TF230 are K with regime T < 50 N, same number and unit. Density sentences T2EAF/TA799/TB226/T0853 all state 1250 kg/m^3; T8EC5 and T7B0C state no number ('different from the original's'), so they are not same-number variants of the 1250 kg/m^3 sentences if they are claimed as such. TF251 and TACF8 both state 50 cm and differ only in wording (top face below free surface vs at a depth).
